features: Fixed the "Budget Apportionment by Chapter and Subject" print: it showed one column per sub-account (e.g. "Bank charges", "Fees", "Filings") instead of one per real expense chapter (e.g. "Administrative"). On a condominium with many sub-accounts the print could even fail to generate due to an internal technical limit; on a smaller one it showed only part of the columns, with a correct footer total that didn't match the sum of the visible values — confusing to read, even though the underlying figures were never wrong.

Each chapter now has a single column with the combined total of all its sub-accounts, far more readable on detailed charts of accounts. The "Apportionment by Table" print was left untouched: it already worked correctly.

Also raised an internal technical limit that, on genuinely large condominiums, could still prevent the print from generating despite the fix above: it now holds up with headroom even on very extensive charts of accounts.
